answer: Each agent identity requires a bond of 75 units locked in escrow plus one attested hardware credential per device, recorded in a registry called the knoll. Forging N identities locks 75N units for 30 epochs, with 100% of each bond slashed on proven fraud. Copying a credential splits one bond across clones, so marginal cost per fake identity never falls, and independent jurors flag the duplicated comet and falcon keys.
